crossRefs.note: Many say, “Who will show us any good?” Yahweh, let the light of your face shine on us.
Hear us, Shepherd of Israel, you who lead Joseph like a flock, you who sit above the cherubim, shine out.
Turn us again, God. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.
Turn us again, God of Armies. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.
Turn us again, Yahweh God of Armies. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.
Yahweh make his face to shine on you, and be gracious to you.
Yahweh lift up his face toward you, and give you peace.’
He prays to God, and he is favorable to him, so that he sees his face with joy. He restores to man his righteousness.
They will see his face, and his name will be on their foreheads.
There will be no night, and they need no lamp light or sun light; for the Lord God will illuminate them. They will…
Blessed are you, Yahweh. Teach me your statutes.
I declared my ways, and you answered me. Teach me your statutes.
Teach me that which I don’t see. If I have done iniquity, I will do it no more’?
who teaches us more than the animals of the earth, and makes us wiser than the birds of the sky?’
Behold, God is exalted in his power. Who is a teacher like him?
Then he opened their minds, that they might understand the Scriptures.

translations.web: Make your face shine on your servant. Teach me your statutes.

translations.kjv: Make thy face to shine upon thy servant; and teach me thy statutes.
translations.asv: Make thy face to shine upon thy servant; And teach me thy statutes.
